predictions.claim: Apple and other smart-glasses makers will wipe out the mid-tier non-smart eyewear market (Ray-Ban, Warby Parker style), while high-end makers like Maison Bonnet and Cartier survive.
predictions.speaker: Mark Gurman
predictions.notes: Analogy to how the Apple Watch upended mid-tier mechanical watches.

predictions.claim: The overall PC market will decline 11% in calendar year 2026.
predictions.speaker: Ed Ludlow (citing IDC forecast)
predictions.notes: IDC forecast cited amid flat DRAM/NAND pricing.

predictions.claim: SpaceX's sum-of-the-parts valuation could reach close to $2 trillion (~$1T launch, ~$600B Starlink, ~$400B AI).
predictions.speaker: George Ferguson
predictions.notes: Ferguson cautions the comparables look rich and aren't necessarily the right price.

predictions.claim: MediaTek's AI data-center chip revenue will multiply next year and the company feels set through the 2030 horizon.
predictions.speaker: Vince Hu
predictions.notes: Tied to tier-one hyperscaler customers and expanding engineering headcount.

predictions.claim: Agentic AI will be a net job and GDP generator, leading companies to hire more software engineers rather than fewer.
predictions.speaker: Jensen Huang
predictions.notes: Echoed by MediaTek's Vince Hu citing Taiwan's ~10% GDP growth.

predictions.claim: Physical AI will be deployed even faster than LLMs because of the economic impact it will have.
predictions.speaker: Amit Jain
predictions.notes: Argued in support of an open-source approach to physical AI.

predictions.claim: Software incumbents (system-of-record players) won't be disintermediated by agentic AI; agents will build on top of existing software, driving more consumption.
predictions.speaker: Mandeep Singh
predictions.notes: Based on Datadog, Snowflake and MongoDB ARR-growth acceleration.
